$description: Hand-authored small glow dots for status indicators and health badges. Distinct from the main `glow` file because the blur radius is deliberately tiny and there's no spread — these are for 4–12 px dot indicators.

sm.$description: Small dot glow — 6 px blur. Idle status indicators.
